What if Luffy joined Smash Bros?

Luffy's rubber body means he never gets launched off stage. He just stretches and grabs the ledge from across the map. His Final Smash is Gear 5, turning the whole stage into a cartoon and Bowser into a balloon. Would Luffy be top tier on day one, or banned from every tournament within a week?
